name: 旧漆铁皮
prompt: Create ONE square opaque seamless material texture filling every pixel. Reference 1 and 2 are approved final hand-painted environment materials; match broad brush-shaped masses and restrained contrast. Other refs guide painted contours and volume but DO NOT draw any prop or character. Flat weathered dull teal painted steel sheet material, broad uneven paint islands, localized gray bare iron and tiny rusty seams, hand-painted solid color masses, not shiny. No rivet grid, no hazard stripes, no logos. Orthographic flat material swatch; NO isometric diamond, camera perspective, pedestal, lighting gradient, border, transparent area, text, rendered room, object shadow, photoreal micro-noise or PBR specular. Large readable painted shapes; visible but subdued wear, not neat showroom. Edges should tile or mirror smoothly.
